views.name: vw_active_policies
views.sql: SELECT policy_id, policy_status, premium_amount FROM insurance.policy.policies WHERE policy_status = 'ACTIVE'

views.name: vw_policy_summary
views.sql: SELECT p.policy_id, p.policy_status, COUNT(c.claim_id) AS claim_count FROM insurance.policy.policies p LEFT JOIN insurance.policy.claims c ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id GROUP BY p.policy_id, p.policy_status

views.name: vw_claims_by_policy
views.sql: SELECT c.claim_id, c.policy_id, c.claim_amount FROM insurance.policy.claims c

views.name: vw_open_claims
views.sql: SELECT c.claim_id, c.policy_id, c.claim_amount, c.claim_status, c.claim_date FROM insurance.policy.claims c WHERE c.claim_status IN ('OPEN', 'PENDING')

views.name: vw_policy_revenue
views.sql: SELECT p.policy_id, p.premium_amount, SUM(pay.payment_amount) AS collected FROM insurance.policy.policies p LEFT JOIN insurance.policy.payments pay ON p.policy_id = pay.policy_id GROUP BY p.policy_id, p.premium_amount

views.name: vw_agent_performance
views.sql: SELECT a.agent_id, a.agent_name, a.region, SUM(p.premium_amount) AS written_premium FROM insurance.policy.policies p JOIN insurance.policy.agents a ON p.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_id, a.agent_name, a.region

views.name: vw_product_mix
views.sql: SELECT pr.line_of_business, pr.product_name, COUNT(p.policy_id) AS policy_count FROM insurance.policy.policies p JOIN insurance.policy.products pr ON p.product_code = pr.product_code GROUP BY pr.line_of_business, pr.product_name

views.name: vw_claims_ratio
views.sql: SELECT p.policy_id, p.premium_amount, SUM(c.claim_amount) AS incurred FROM insurance.policy.policies p LEFT JOIN insurance.policy.claims c ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id GROUP BY p.policy_id, p.premium_amount

views.name: vw_payment_health
views.sql: SELECT pay.payment_status, pay.payment_method, COUNT(pay.payment_id) AS payments, SUM(pay.payment_amount) AS amount FROM insurance.policy.payments pay GROUP BY pay.payment_status, pay.payment_method

queries.sql: SELECT policy_status, COUNT(*) AS policy_count FROM insurance.policy.policies GROUP BY policy_status
SELECT date_trunc('month', effective_date) AS month, SUM(premium_amount) AS total_premium FROM insurance.policy.policies GROUP BY 1
SELECT c.loss_type, COUNT(c.claim_id) AS claims, SUM(c.claim_amount) AS amount FROM insurance.policy.claims c GROUP BY c.loss_type
SELECT a.agent_name, a.channel, SUM(p.premium_amount) AS premium FROM insurance.policy.policies p JOIN insurance.policy.agents a ON p.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name, a.channel
SELECT pay.payment_method, COUNT(pay.payment_id) AS payments FROM insurance.policy.payments pay GROUP BY pay.payment_method
SELECT pr.product_name, SUM(p.premium_amount) AS premium FROM insurance.policy.policies p JOIN insurance.policy.products pr ON p.product_code = pr.product_code GROUP BY pr.product_name
